description: This file defines the GatewayEventHandler class responsible for managing wake words synchronization between the app and a gateway service, including scheduling, updating, and refreshing wake words, with coroutine-based asynchronous handling.

classes.name: GatewayEventHandler
classes.description: Handles synchronization and updates of wake words between the application and a gateway service, including scheduling and processing events.

methods.name: applyWakeWordsFromGateway
methods.description: Sets wake words in preferences and temporarily suppresses the sync process.

methods.name: scheduleWakeWordsSyncIfNeeded
methods.description: Schedules a delayed sync request to set wake words on the gateway if connected and not suppressed.

methods.name: refreshWakeWordsFromGateway
methods.description: Requests current wake words from the gateway and applies them locally.

methods.name: handleVoiceWakeChangedEvent
methods.description: Processes a JSON payload indicating wake word changes and applies them.
